description: This is a main package source file for the host_orchestrator component of a larger Android Cuttlefish project. It sets up an HTTP server, reverse proxy, and orchestrates various initialization routines.

methods.name: defaultCVDArtifactsDir
methods.description: Returns the default directory path for CVD artifacts based on the current user's UID.

methods.name: startHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server listening on a specified address and port.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Runs a list of startup routines concurrently, waits for all to complete, and handles errors appropriately.

methods.name: newOperatorProxy
methods.description: Creates a new reverse proxy for the operator service at a specified port.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point for the host orchestrator, parses flags, initializes components, and starts the HTTP server.
